scope: Source-specific Earth and eclipse cues without diagram text

shots.narration_cue: Understand that the Earth is spherical
shots.prompt: A polished child-friendly 3D animated classroom. One blue-and-green spherical Earth globe turns gently on a wooden desk near a sunny window. The camera glides a little closer while the globe stays centered and continues rotating naturally for five continuous seconds. Warm soft light, clear round shape, a calm sense of discovery, and no other moving objects competing with the globe.

shots.narration_cue: Earth's shadow on the Moon is curved
shots.prompt: A close, clear child-friendly 3D animation of one full Moon against a deep blue night sky. A smooth dark curved shadow slowly moves across the bright Moon's round face during a lunar eclipse. The camera stays steady and close so the curved edge of the shadow is unmistakable throughout one continuous five-second shot. Soft natural lunar lighting and a simple uncluttered view.
